verdict.rationale: Missive's developer docs list webhooks as a first-party developer tool alongside the REST API. That one line is the only evidence: nothing documents how to register webhooks, which events can be subscribed to, or what the payloads look like. Missing for 10: documented webhook registration (API or UI), list of subscribable event types, payload and signature/retry details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Missive developer tools: REST API, UI integrations, webhooks, and custom channels for full customization.
